This site contains materials for Dr. Tim Johnson's *Survey Sampling Methods* course (Stat 422) at the University of Idaho for the fall semester of 2024.

The [Rmarkdown](https://rmarkdown.rstudio.com/) source files for everything on this website can be viewed at [https://github.com/trobinj/stat516/tree/gh-pages](https://github.com/trobinj/stat422/tree/gh-pages). These are the files with the .Rmd extension.
